reasoning: The stakeholder identifies a misstatement in the judgment. They argue that the judgment incorrectly characterizes the analyst as having "an apparent inability to reconcile the card value '1' with its designated supreme strength," when the record shows the analyst actually demonstrated awareness of the strength order (2 < 3 < ... < 13 < 1). This is presented as a defect in how the judgment characterized the analyst's understanding.
